canDoYue: 你識講年假日期、邊個接手、交接、批核、電郵確認同公眾假期。
canDoEn: Ask for annual leave, name who covers the desk, send a handover, and ask for email approval around a public holiday.

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: I would like annual leave next week on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday, but not on Wednesday.
dialogue.glossYue: 我想下星期請年假，星期一、二、四、五，星期三唔請。
dialogue.say: I would like annual leave next week on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday, but not on Wednesday.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Wednesday is a public holiday next week, so your leave days are Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday.
dialogue.glossYue: 下星期星期三係公眾假期，所以你放假係星期一、二、四、五。
dialogue.say: Wednesday is a public holiday next week, so your leave days are Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday.

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: Jo will cover my desk next week, and I can send that handover note this Friday morning.
dialogue.glossYue: Jo 下星期會睇我張檯，我星期五朝早可以送交接筆記。
dialogue.say: Jo will cover my desk next week, and I can send that handover note this Friday morning.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Please email me that full handover note on Friday, and I will approve those four dates then.
dialogue.glossYue: 請星期五將完整交接筆記電郵畀我，我到時就批核嗰四日。
dialogue.say: Please email me that full handover note on Friday, and I will approve those four dates then.

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: Can you please approve those four dates once you read the Friday note and email me back?
dialogue.glossYue: 你睇完星期五嗰張筆記，可唔可以批核嗰四日，再電郵覆我？
dialogue.say: Can you please approve those four dates once you read the Friday note and email me back?

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: I will approve those four dates, and I will email you right after I read that note.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會批核嗰四日，睇完筆記就即刻電郵你。
dialogue.say: I will approve those four dates, and I will email you right after I read that note.

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: I will write the full handover note this Friday, just before my first leave day on Monday.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會喺星期五寫好完整交接筆記，就喺星期一第一日放假之前。
dialogue.say: I will write the full handover note this Friday, just before my first leave day on Monday.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Your annual leave starts on Monday next week, and I have approved those four dates already today.
dialogue.glossYue: 你下星期一年假由星期一起，我今日已經批核咗嗰四日。
dialogue.say: Your annual leave starts on Monday next week, and I have approved those four dates already today.
